name: Dead By 3PM
source:
It's the 90s and you're in senior year. You just gotta get through this year and then it's finally off to college.

Everyone knows weirdos can be cool in college!

Unfortunately getting through this year is already going poorly, when notorious bully Rich decides to shake you down for cash. If you can't get him what he needs you'll be in big trouble.

[From [url=https://bluesquirrel.itch.io/dead-by-3pm]Itch.io[/url]]
